input.rationale: The grant in Article II.iii runs to Licensee alone, and the "notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary" restrictions bar any use or access by third parties (p0041) or by "any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee" (p0045), so Affiliates are excluded with no path to add them. On transfer, Article XX(a) provides that the licence "shall automatically terminate" on a Change of Control (asset sale, merger or control transfer) absent Licensor's prior written consent, which Licensor may withhold on broad grounds, and the assignment clause routes all M&A to that section. The clause therefore fails both fallback elements. We have targeted the fallback: Affiliates covered on written notice (with the two conflicting use restrictions conformed) and continuation/transfer to a successor in an M&A. We have not pursued the preferred items (contractor coverage, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up rights, termination only for uncured material breach under the 36-month term in Article IV).

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Licensee's Affiliates on written notice and allow the licence to continue/transfer to a successor on a Change of Control instead of terminating.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that the licence must cover our Affiliates and survive a merger or acquisition, so we have extended the grant to Affiliates identified by written notice (conforming only the two use restrictions that would otherwise bar them) and provided that on a Change of Control the licence continues and may transfer to our successor rather than terminating.
